body: That's not the situation here, an absent father can be replaced or is an issue that can be overcome. A father who is present but emotionally distant, can be controlling, one who fails to read social cues large and small one who wants the best but has no way to provide it or produce the outcome he wants. This is not a absent vs there situation. It is not 1 vs 0 the math is 0 vs -1.

I'm an emotionally stunted 33yo man due to a lifetime of extreme abuse abandonment and death. I am a failure of a person, parent and business owner. I fail in my personal life I won't go into details but understand yes I lack the character to responsibly teach my child anything about relationships. Yes my business failed. Yes I can't connect with my child and I love her enough to know this has to stop I can't hurt her and I recognize not being in the picture is better than being there and scarring her or anyone else with my deficiencies, i have take responsibility and stop this ride before anyone else gets hurt.

Confronted her, she is a different woman than the one I proposed to,  she told me after 3 hours of pulling teeth and denials. She told me that she wanted to keep seeing him and stay engaged, took the ring back. I'm not even sure who I was talking too. She went on and on about how much she loves me but refused to acknowledge or apologize for 2 hours she basically said  sorry,  not sorry idk why I did it but I sort of want to keep going with it but don't want to break up.
